credits_author: Developed by Stefano D'Angelo AKA Lemonice
credits_subtitle: Windows 11 Remote Controller via Telegram Bot
credits_tech_desc:
Libraries and Technologies Used:

• Python 3.11+ & Asyncio Threading
• CustomTkinter (Cyberpunk Graphical Interface)
• python-telegram-bot (Telegram API v20+)
• Windows Credential Manager (keyring) & DPAPI
• cryptography (Fernet AES-CBC / HMAC)
• psutil (Process Management & Uptime)
• pystray & Pillow (System Tray Integration)
• Winreg & ctypes (Native Windows 11 Integration)
